error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
file_rule: rule files are the names augenrules loads: no leading dot, ending in .rules; lstat without following links; /etc/audit/rules.d absent is VALUE <rules-dir-absent> FAIL; a directory that is not a root directory without group/other write is ERROR auditd-rules:dir-untrusted; a rule file that is not a regular file is ERROR auditd-rules:invalid-type; owner other than uid 0 or group/other write is ERROR auditd-rules:untrusted; NUL bytes are ERROR auditd-rules:invalid-bytes
kernel_rule: /usr/sbin/auditctl absent or not executable is VALUE <auditctl-absent> FAIL; auditctl -l with a nonzero exit is ERROR auditd-rules:auditctl-failed; a rule is loaded when its normalized form is an exact line of the auditctl -l output
line_rule: a rule is present in files when a line of any rule file, without surrounding spaces and tabs, equals either its table 1 form or its normalized auditctl -l form
source_rule: fstec-logging-2025 appendix 2 item 4 requires configuring audit rules with auditctl in /etc/audit/audit.rules and /etc/audit/rules.d/*.rules and gives table 1 of example rules; by user decision 30.09.2026 (variant B) the 25 table 1 rules without the myapp example are one control; forms per auditd segmentation map v6 (user decision 01.10.2026)
value_rule: VALUE is files=<n>/25 kernel=<m>/25; PASS only when n = m = 25
